build_map_encoder_with_backbone: build a MapEncoder with a configurable backbone to encode map embeddings into feature maps
create_map_encoder_embeddings: create a MapEncoder that builds nn.Embedding layers for areas, ways, and nodes from num_classes config
run_map_encoder_forward: run the MapEncoder forward pass to produce map_features and optional log_prior from map data
review_map_encoder_unary_prior: review the MapEncoder unary_prior option that extracts a log_prior channel from feature maps
test_map_encoder_simple_backbone: test the MapEncoder simple backbone which uses three Conv2d layers with ReLU activations
